descriptions.zh: 自从[Root.GetAdj]开始掌管[Root.Capital.GetName]起，把[necrophage_species.GetNamePlural]转化为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就被纳入了宗教仪式中。每隔转瞬即逝的十年，“信徒”们都会聚集在升格之室里举行一场特殊的仪式。尽管少数几个知情者对仪式的具体内容三缄其口，但是当他们再次出现时，他们的举止变得与[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]无异。
descriptions.en: Ever since the [Root.GetAdj] takeover of [Root.Capital.GetName], the transformation of [necrophage_species.GetNamePlural] into [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has been shrouded in ritual. Once every ten years - a date which is rapidly approaching - the "Apprentices" gather in the Chamber of Elevation for a special ceremony. What exactly happens to them is a closely-guarded secret known only to a select few, but when they emerge, they do so as [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

descriptions.zh: 自从[Root.GetAdj]开始掌管[Root.Capital.GetName]起，把[necrophage_species.GetNamePlural]转化为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就被纳入了仪式中。每隔转瞬即逝的十年，“信徒”们都会聚集在升格之室里举行一场特殊的仪式。尽管集体意识对仪式的具体内容三缄其口，但是当他们再次出现时，他们的举止变得与[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]子个体无异。
descriptions.en: Ever since the [Root.GetAdj] takeover of [Root.Capital.GetName], the transformation of [necrophage_species.GetNamePlural] into [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] has been shrouded in ritual. Once every ten years - a date which is rapidly approaching - the "Apprentices" gather in the Chamber of Elevation for a special ceremony. What exactly happens to them is a secret closely-guarded by our collective consciousness, but when they emerge, they do so as [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] drones.

tooltips.zh:
到今年年底，§H[Root.Capital.GetName]§!上的§H[necro_apprentice.GetNamePlural]§!将会全部被转化成§H[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!。

这个仪式将每隔§H10§!年在各个建有§H升格之室§![Root.GetAdj]星球上举行一次。
tooltips.en:
At the end of the year, all §H[necro_apprentice.GetNamePlural]§! on §H[Root.Capital.GetName]§! will be converted into §H[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!.

This ceremony will take place every §H10 years§! on each [Root.GetAdj] planet with a §HChamber of Elevation§!.

descriptions.zh: 死灵机师协议的成功安装使我们得以将被击溃的特定星神兽复活。相比机械升级，有机组件是劣等的。我们可以改造肉体，制造出有机生命的复制品。
descriptions.en: The successful installation of Mechromancy protocols will enable us to reanimate certain deceased Leviathans. Organic components are inferior to mechanical upgrades. We can engineer the flesh and produce a facsimile of organic life.
